scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of any North Eastern State
Admission must be in Diploma, Degree, Post‑graduate or registration in M.Phil/Ph.D. courses of a government‑recognized institute
Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying examination for the respective level
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from any source
In case of a tie, preference is given to the candidate with lower family income
No reservation or quota based on category, religion, or gender
Scholarship is disbursed only through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
benefits_summary: Scholarship amounts up to ₹30,000 per annum (₹20,000 for Diploma, ₹22,000 for Degree, ₹25,000 for Post‑graduate and ₹30,000 for M.Phil/Ph.D.) are provided to eligible students and are paid via the National Scholarship Portal.
documents_required: Previous exam marks sheet or pass certificate
